body: Interesting dito ang gap between ‘alam kong may recall’ at ‘ginawa ko na ang recall.’ Kapag years nang gumagana ang appliance without incident, madaling gawing evidence ang sariling experience: ‘okay naman sa bahay ko.’ Pero absence of failure so far is not proof of safety. Mas useful ang rule: kapag low-effort at free ang remedy pero severe ang downside, huwag gawing personal experiment ang bahay mo para patunayan na rare ang risk.

claims.text: For a free, low-effort recall remedy addressing a potentially severe fire hazard, prior trouble-free personal use is weak justification for delaying the remedy.
claims.basis: Normative risk-management inference from the article's established recall facts, not a new factual claim.
